question: What has changed at Merrill since the start of the year?

claims.text: Recruiting (trade press, 2026-11-16): a UBS broker, Franklin J. Laden, joined Merrill in Denver, managing $375 million in assets and joining the existing LDSO Group team. Merrill also added an advisor managing $205 million from Morgan Stanley in California and another overseeing $150 million from Edward D. Jones & Co. in Texas, according to a Merrill spokesperson cited by the publication.

Recruiting strategy (trade press, 2026-11-16): the publication reports that Merrill executives in October touted that recruited assets to the wealth unit doubled year-over-year as the firm has returned to veteran broker recruiting. It says Merrill largely pulled back from this at the end of 2017 and returned after Co-Presidents Lindsay Hans and Eric Schimpf, who took over in 2023, restored a focus on hiring and a more aggressive offer.

Alternatives and AI (trade press, 2026-10-14): Eric Schimpf, president and co-head of Merrill Wealth Management, said client sales of alternative investments at Merrill increased 19% in the quarter. The publication says that, while he did not mention new AI tools, the message was clear that the firm would continue to invest in AI and digital capabilities.

3Q26 results (BAC earnings materials, 2026-10-14): Merrill Wealth Management reported $4.2 trillion in client balances, $1.9 trillion in AUM balances and about 4.2K net new $500K+ households added in 3Q26. On the call, the CFO said Merrill added about 4,200 net new households with at least $500,000 in assets, up 17%, and that 67% of Merrill clients have banking relationships with the firm. Merrill reported 87% of households digitally active and 70K digital appointments scheduled in the quarter.

Data fees (trade press, 2026-09-29): a Merrill filing states a new policy will "favor third-party firms that select data analytics with higher fees." The publication reports that Merrill is imposing new data fees on third-party managers, and an analyst it quotes says large and mid-size firms can absorb them while start-up and niche managers are effectively priced out.

New services (Merrill press release, 2026-09-15): Merrill announced the launch of Tax Efficient Transition Service (TET) and Dollar Cost Averaging Service (DCA). Both are available through the Merrill Lynch Investment Advisory Program and implemented by Managed Account Advisors LLC.

2Q26 (BAC 10-Q filed 2026-07-31 and 2Q26 press release 2026-07-14): Merrill Wealth Management revenue was $5,711 million for the quarter versus $4,942 million a year earlier, and $11,290 million for six months versus $9,961 million. Client balances were $4,132,451 million versus $3,695,213 million a year earlier. The firm reported about 5.4K net new $500K+ households in Merrill in 2Q26 and $1.8 trillion in AUM balances.

1Q26 (BAC supplement, 2026-04-15): Merrill Wealth Management revenue was $5,579 million, against $5,494 million in 4Q25 and $5,019 million in 1Q25. Client balances were $3,815,389 million at 3/31/26, down from $3,992,312 million at year-end 2025.

Starting point (BAC 2025 10-K, published 2026-02-25): for full-year 2025, Merrill Wealth Management revenue was $20,716 million versus $19,066 million in 2024, and year-end 2025 client balances were $3,992,312 million. The filing describes the advisory business as a network of financial advisors focused on clients with over $250,000 in total investable assets.

adjacent.text: GWIM 3Q26 (2026-10-14): pretax margin improved to 29%, return on average allocated capital was 28%, and average loans and leases of $279 billion increased 13%. In 1Q26 the GWIM operating margin was 26 percent compared with 22 percent a year earlier.
adjacent.differs_because: GWIM includes both Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank; the two have different reporting scopes, so GWIM figures are not Merrill's.

gaps.what: Merrill does not report standalone results.
gaps.suggested_source: Bank of America quarterly earnings supplement or 10-Q (only revenue and client balances are split out for Merrill Wealth Management; profit and margin are reported at GWIM level)

gaps.what: Merrill advisor headcount change in 2026 is not found in the evidence provided.
gaps.suggested_source: Bank of America earnings supplement or Merrill management commentary on advisor headcount
